# One page.<br>Two ways<br>to experience it.
summary: You are already reading LightWebPres. Scroll through this page, or press the right arrow to present it.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: une-source
kicker: THE IDEA
## Your source stays text.
summary: Write content cards and, when needed, a long-form article. The engine brings them together in one page.
highlight: .md → .html
highlight-caption: One source file per article. One HTML page per article.
source: <a href="reference/README.md">README · One page, two uses</a>; <a href="ecrire.html">Writing in the LWP format</a>.

No opaque presentation format to maintain. Titles, content and links live in files you can review and version.

<div class="lwp-web-actions"><a class="lwp-web-button" href="downloads/demarrage.zip" download>Get the example ↓</a><a href="demo/ma-page.html">Open its generated page →</a></div>

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: deux-usages
kicker: READ OR PRESENT
## Content adapts. It does not disappear.
summary: On a phone, scroll. In landscape, navigate with a mouse or keyboard. Long content remains available by scrolling.
source: <a href="guide/guide.html#8-present-print-and-share">Guide · Present, print and share</a>.

![The same LightWebPres content card in portrait and landscape, using the Nebula theme.](img/product-responsive.png)

Press **F** for fullscreen: rotating the screen does not activate it automatically.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: commandes
kicker: TRY IT NOW
## The controls are already here.
summary: No viewer to install: the controls travel with every article.
source: <a href="guide/guide.html#8-present-print-and-share">Guide · Keyboard and Speaker panel</a>.
note: This is a presentation note. Its panel is visible on the same screen as the deck. Do not put confidential information here.

<div class="lwp-web-key-grid"><div><kbd>→</kbd><strong>Move forward</strong><span>The next card</span></div><div><kbd>F</kbd><strong>Present</strong><span>Fullscreen</span></div><div><kbd>C</kbd><strong>Change appearance</strong><span>Identity, preset, theme</span></div><div><kbd>N</kbd><strong>Read the notes</strong><span>A public panel</span></div></div>

Press **H** for the full help. The share button offers a link to the series, article or card; QR codes require a reachable HTTP(S) address.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: fichiers-libres
kicker: TAKE IT WITH YOU
## Your page does not need the engine to be read.
summary: CSS and JavaScript are embedded in each article. Local images stay alongside it in the published directory.
fact-label: A useful distinction
source: <a href="reference/README.md">README · Portable pages</a>; <a href="guide/guide.html#7-verify-and-publish">Guide · Verify and publish</a>.

The **generator** uses Python. The **reader** uses a browser. Open the HTML locally, or publish the entire **public/** directory on static hosting.

The `--inline-images` option embeds Markdown images when a self-contained delivery is needed; `verify` does not reproduce this mode.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: pour-qui
kicker: WHEN TO USE IT
## When the substance should outlast the presentation.
summary: A course to revisit, documentation to demonstrate, a talk to share: the same text can work before, during and afterwards.
source: <a href="reference/README.md">README · Content model and Safety</a>; <a href="ressources.html#skills">The two skills</a>.

LightWebPres does not choose your argument or check your facts. It renders trusted sources and accepts raw HTML: it is not a sanitizer for outside content.
